memories.text:
- Hypertension
  - Status: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 58 kg, waist 78 cm (<80 cm cut-off).
  - Plan: Start amlodipine 5 mg OD morning after food, telmisartan 40 mg OD morning after food. Advise low‑salt diet, avoid processed snacks.
- Migraine
  - Status: 2‑3 episodes/month, each lasting 4‑6 hrs, sumatriptan used SOS.
  - Plan: Start propranolol 40 mg OD morning after food for prophylaxis, topiramate 25 mg HS. Counsel regular sleep, hydration.
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: whole grain toast with egg, no added salt.
  - Lunch: rice, dal, vegetable curry, limited pickle.
  - Dinner: chapati, lean curd, avoid fried items.
- Due: next review in 3 months.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed my migraines are worse when I skip meals during site visits. I usually have only tea and biscuits. Can you suggest a quick, portable snack that won’t trigger headaches?

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

  - Status: BP 126/80 mmHg, weight 57.5 kg, waist 78 cm.
  - Plan: Continue amlodipine, telmisartan, losartan. Reinforce low‑salt, high‑fiber diet.
- Migraine
